rules.title: Only the lander merges
rules.description: A PR lands only through the lander: one at a time by default, or through the merge queue while its switch is on. No direct merge and no merge outside the lander; drafts and forks never land.
rules.source: shared rule Nov 4 2026 (Merge queue switch Nov 15 2026); config.json autoLand, mergeQueue, queueMode, queueDepth, batchSize

rules.title: CI green
rules.description: Every check is green on the commit that lands (the PR head, or the queue commit built on main). Red = needs a code fix; running or not started = waits.

rules.title: Tests after regeneration
rules.description: The quick tests the generated-files manifest asks for pass after the lander resolved generated and additive files.

rules.title: Theme tokens
rules.description: Every colour, size, spacing, font, radius and border comes from asset tokens (check-theme).

rules.title: Framework controls
rules.description: UI uses framework controls, never raw ones (check-controls).

rules.title: Toolbars
rules.description: Every toolbar has role="toolbar" and an aria-label; tab rows are the framework TabGroup (check-toolbars).

rules.title: UI Review
rules.description: A PR whose UI Review is waiting, has changes asked or is rejected does not land; one UI Review couldn't read waits.

rules.title: No code clash with main
rules.description: Builds, union and generated files are resolved by the lander; a code conflict files a fix and the PR waits for it.
